_README: Hand-made corrections applied on top of the scaffold produced by
scripts/extract_registry.py. Each entry records WHAT was changed, WHY,
and against WHICH source it was verified — so the correction is itself
evidence, and so regenerating the scaffold never silently reverts it.
Keyed by ИНН where one exists, otherwise by slug.
'set'          overwrites fields on the matching scaffold record
'add_entities' appends whole records the scaffold could not produce
(e.g. the second company in a compound table row)
'people'       same as 'set' but for people.json, keyed by slug
(personal ИНН/DOB/etc are re-derived from source text
every run, so a plain JSON edit does not survive
re-running extract_registry.py — must go through here)
Once verification is complete the extractor is retired and the registry
is hand-edited directly; this file stays as the change log.
